comment: Dr. Kandeh is amazing! He is all over the place sometimes, but he is brilliant. He gives good feedback for papers during office hours, but you'll probably end up spending an hour there listening to all his cool stories about Sierra Leone. Do most of the readings, copy everything he writes on the board and if you are good at writing, you'll do great

Very clear-cut class. Attendance isn't mandatory. Pay attention to the lectures and write down everything on the board and you will do fine on the two exams that make up 80% of the grade. However, his grading criteria for test answers is arbitrary which makes it hard to get an A/A-. For most people, a B+ is very doable. Books aren't required.

Super laid back professor that knows his stuff. Attendance isn't mandatory but I recommend you go to each and every class because the notes he puts on the board are pretty much what is going to be on the exam. Copy everything he puts on that board.

Easy. Don't worry about participation.  Take enough time on take home final to answer all parts and be honest in your paper and you get an A-.  Only one day of attendance (random) which I missed and still got A- on everything.  No feedback though

Dr. Kandeh is awesome.  His class isn't hard at all…that may or may not be a good thing though.  I don't feel like I absorbed/learned as much as I should have.  Easy class to fulfill your gen ed requirement though.
Dr. Kandeh is the man. I definitely reccommend taking class with him.

He's like really not that easy. He's a cool guy and makes class as interesting as it can be, but he doesn't give a lot of feedback on the midterm or the paper and the final is worth 40%--it would be easy to get a B but an A not so much

Kandeh's class was extremely boring. Although class was only 75 minutes, it felt like it dragged on for 4 hours. That being said, if you want to take care of the GenEd, I suggest his class. We only had 4 grades: the midterm, final, a book review, and participation (which I never did and still got an A-). I never read and did fine. No other homework

There is no doubt that Dr. Kandeh is brilliant in his field; however, it is clear that he has no interest in getting to know his students. I don't think he knew anybody's name in my class, and he rarely responds to emails.
The guy is flat out the man.

Very cool professor, knows a lot about his subject and his experiences with Africa are interesting. I took him for two classes (IR and Pol. of Africa) over the summer and I got an A- in each without too much effort. I just payed attention, showed up, and did a little of the reading (by no means all).

If you're not really into professors who lecture, he is not for you. Class consists of him talking throughout most of it, while he asks specific questions and expects specific answers. While class tends to be pretty boring, the information is pretty interesting and he is a really easy grader. If you are at all interested in Africa, take the class!

Kandeh is one of the most amazing professors at this school!  I was not amazed by his IR 250 class but taking him for politics of africa was the best decision I've ever made.  He a genius and has great stories.  Anyone who can't understand his accent is an idiot.
Cultural Pluralism                02
Kandeh is amazing!!  He is liberal but does not have a problem with other opinions if you can back it up.  He does not give out As but an A- is to achieve.  I highly recomend this class!

Easy to get an A-, hard to get an A.  Heavy use of textbook, but he'll explain everything you need for the midterm and final in class.  Attendance isn't mandatory, but you can't miss too many, because he tells you stuff that isn't in the books but you need for the tests in class lecture.  Nice guy, very willing to help.

Jimmy Kandeh is the best teacher I've ever had in my life.  I normally don't like teachers who lecture with little student participation, but he explains everything so clearly and presents the material in a way that keeps you interested.  In short, he's the man!
It is easy to get an A- in his class, but it is very difficult to get an A. With only four assignments, there isn't much room for error.
He is a genius.  Difficult to understand at time when talking about your-o-peaon diplomacy, but regardless interesting, funny and entertaining.

VERY GOOD AT EXPLAINING THINGS.  HIS ACCENT IS NOT DIFFICULT TO UNDERSTAND.  LIKES TO TALK ABOUT BURKINA FASO IN EXAMPLES.  LAX PAPER GRADER.  NEVER BIG ON RESEARCH-BASED ASSIGNMENTS.  EASY MIDTERM.  ALTHOUGH THE CLASS IS FAIRLY EASY, I FEEL LIKE I LEARN A LOT.  NICE GUY AND GREAT TEACHER.

This guy is the man, if you can't understand his accent, then you don't belong in the school. Very concise and a great guy to get to know. I would recomend him to every one of Politics of Cultural Pluralism and IR.
No Comments

My favorite professor.  Everything on the exam comes from class notes.  He always plays devil's advocate and makes you really back up what you say.  He'll surprise you by knowing your name and noticing that you weren't in class.  Very good dresser.
Easy to get A-/B+. don't take it if you're actually interested in the class... you won't learn a thing.  He uses miserable videos once a week
Dr. Kandeh is an awesome guy.  There are only 4 grades for the semester so no busy work.  He covers the final exam in class notes.  Also is very good at playing devil's advocate!

Dr. Kandeh is great.  Easiest A I've ever gotten in PLSC - he tells you everything you need to know for the tests during class lectures. I know many people who didn't even buy the books. His accent isn't an issue once you get used to it.
His accent is really hard to understand and I had huge gaps in my notes by the time it came around to studying for tests.
Continues to amaze. I have taken him three times and  done three less reading assignments than that, total. Always a B+. Sit in the front, once he knows your name you can stop coming to class.

Really easy teacher, you barely have to read after the first week.  Fun to learn from and very interesting.  He IS very liberal (for Richmond) but he's NOT suppressive; for him, "my opinion is valid" just isn't a good enough reason without proof
No Comments
he presents his opinion as valid and is not open for others also he does not like to give out A's
SO Politically Biased and he forces you to agree.  Take him if you like intellectual supression and having facts called "misinformation"
A great teacher.  Very clear and few assignments.  If you have a comment make sure it's got some backing because he will make you question it.
lecture style, interesting, good class, easy to get B+/A-, but doesn't like to give out As
International relations with him is the only way to go...forget about taking it with anyone else.
